name: s3ListBucket
syntax: s3ListBucket(bucketName [, listener, blockfactor, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Lists the objects in an S3 bucket, as a query.

params.name: listener
params.description: A function or component that receives the listed objects.

params.name: blockfactor
params.description: The number of objects to fetch per request.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first argument `bucket` and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Takes `prefix` and `maxKeys` as the second and third arguments instead of `listener` and `blockfactor`, and returns an array of structs with `key`, `size`, `lastModified`, `eTag`, `storageClass` and `isDirectory`. Doesn't list `timeout`.

examples.title: List the objects in a bucket
examples.description: Returns a query of the bucket's objects.
